text:
morgan: Quick async check — traffic-shape status for today. Did: pushed routing policy v3 to staging (edge-config update). Blocker: seeing higher 429s on long-tail routes in staging during batching tests. Today: canary to prod in afternoon if we confirm fallback works. PR: #4523 is ready for review.

alex: reviewing PR now, saw failing unit in auth middleware, likely due to JWT expiry handling. will push fix today. any repro steps?

morgan: repro: hit /v1/generate with long prompt and header `x-client-tier: free`. Staging cmd:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <STAG_TOKEN>" -H "x-client-tier: free" "https://staging.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```
Observed: 429s after ~6 concurrent requests. cc @maya for rate limits.

maya: saw same in last run — suspect continuous batching bump. Suggest lowering `max_batch_size` from 64->32 for free-tier routes. I'll open a quick config PR.

lee: FYI auth rotation job ran at 03:00UTC and rotated a subset of tokens; double-check that staging token was updated in secrets. I think some 401s we saw were from stale tokens, not 429s.

alex: fixed unit, pushed commit to PR. also added better logging around `kv_cache_size` to trace latency spikes.

morgan: thanks @alex. maya — if you can submit config PR, can we run a 30m soak in staging at 17:00 PST? I'll coordinate deploy window. Need one volunteer to watch for 429/error spike and tag incident channel.

maya: PR opened: #4526 — changes to `edge-config.yaml` (reduced max_batch_size). Also added a canary flag `traffic_shape.v3.canary: true` so we can toggle.

ci-bot: deploy started for staging at 1719999005 by morgan (edge-config:PR4526). Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345

lee: I'll watch from 17:00 PST, ping in #eng-oncall if we hit >5% 429s over 5m. :eyes: 

morgan: perfect. Alex — can you also review the auth middleware PR? Need it merged before canary.

alex: on it, should be green in ~20m.

morgan: async note: please add small smoke script to `eng/tools/traffic-check` that hits weighted routes to mimic free vs paid tiers. makes future repro faster.

maya: adding that too. ETA end of day.

lee: small note — update runbook step 3 to include `curl` with `x-client-tier` header.

morgan: done (runbook updated). Thanks team. :thumbsup:
